type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Complete Regime Equality framework - all phases done

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.anti_projection
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} {R : RegimeContract α} {a b : α} : (a ≡[R] b) → R.anti_projection a b → a ≠ b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.arithmetic_protection
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} [Ring α] {R : RegimeContract α} {a b : α} : (a ≡[R] b) → R.anti_projection a b → (a + a) ≠ (b + b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.contract_violation_implies_invalid
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} {R : RegimeContract α} {a b : α} : (∃ c d, R.sufficiency c d ∧ R.anti_projection c d ∧ c = d) → ¬(a ≡[R] b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.regime_coherence
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} (R : RegimeContract α) : ∀ a b : α, (a ≡[R] b) → R.functional_role a ∧ R.functional_role b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.regime_refl
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} (R : RegimeContract α) (a : α) : R.functional_role a → R.sufficiency a a → a ≡[R] a

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RegimeEquality.regime_separation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} : ∀ (a b : α) (R : RegimeContract α) (ε : ℝ), (a ≡[R] b) → ¬(a =[E1] b ∧ ¬R.valid a b)
